data.content_ref: inline:Total widgets: 24. Total cost: $36. Justification: Let P be a pack, a structured pair (w=6, c=$9). The total T = P⊕P⊕P⊕P = (4·6, 4·$9) = (24, $36), where ⊕ denotes componentwise addition over the widget-cost semiring. The result is the unique fixed point of scaling the generator P by the scalar 4.
